reviews.title: AI Usage
reviews.text: I had this app for about 2 weeks and I loved it a lot. But then I realized that they use AI and some of the facts are wrong. I'm super disappointed because I love the concept of the app. Maybe if this gets fixed and Nerdish becomes credible I'll redownload it.

reviews.title: AI Usage
reviews.text: If you’re not looking for it or thinking about it, you will miss that they use AI, OR it might even be marketed to you that they are AI free, as it was for me. I don’t specifically blame Nerdish for that marketing because I heard about it from someone else promoting them. I started reading an article and immediately got this feeling that they were using AI, and sure enough, if you go into Settings and FAQ, they say that they have a team of real human editors, but they admit that they use AI with the excuse that “most modern companies do.” I do appreciate the upfront honesty about it, but this is no excuse!!! AI is untrustworthy in its sources and information. There are other reviews even complaining about inaccurate information. Even if they’re not using it for “aiding in” writing the articles (which I doubt), AI data centers are putting our planet at HIGH risk of destruction and ruin, not to mention all of the jobs that AI is taking from artists. Please Nerdish, if you read this, I beg you to reconsider. I love the concept of this app. I really wish I could bring myself to enjoy it, but as a human who highly values art, intelligence, our planet, and HUMAN made connections and knowledge… I just can’t.

reviews.title: Great App Idea, Poorly Executed
reviews.text:
I love the idea behind this app, but ended up deleting the app after reading one article. This was due to the poor writing style and citations.

When downloading Nerdish I was looking for reads that would be approachable while still intellectual. What was read lacked scholastic level writing. Keywords/citations were misspelled, the citation format was inconsistent, no rhetorical awareness, etc. 

If I am going to an app for knowledge, articles should be written by an author that is an academic, professional, or expert in the subject matter.

reviews.title: Uneducated education
reviews.text: Apparently limited number of articles. Consistently poor writing eroded my faith in the quality of the information, although I did enjoy learning from a few articles. I bought a three month subscription but canceled after less than two weeks.

reviews.title: Suggestion!
reviews.text: I love this app, I am constantly learning new things every day and it has a wide variety of topics to choose from. However, a feature that I believe would better this app is adding comprehension questions after you are finished reading your article. Overall, though, this app has been amazing otherwise and I can’t wait to see how it advances in the future!

reviews.title: It’s nice, but too many incorrect “facts”
reviews.text: This app is great for some topics I’ll give it that, but as someone who’s taken many courses on various subjects, some things are simply incorrect. For instance, I was reading one subject they had called “What did our ancestors eat?” And not only did they use the standard image of evolution (which has been proven to not be accurate at all) but they also stated that women mostly gathered and men hunted (while still gathering). While this is a very common misconception, it was actually very 50 50 on who hunted and who gathered. In fact, the reason why we were lead to believe this was because of archeologists back in I believe the 1900’s, who had such sexist ideals they simply imagined that it was the women who gathered and do all of the meal preparations while the men went out and hunted for meat. This has since been proven to be incorrect. Anyways, my point is that this app needs to get its facts straight. There’s still a great deal to learn from it, but you should have some aloud in each subject in order to see what’s true or not.

reviews.title: Two things…
reviews.text:
I like this app, a lot! But I want to ask the Developers two things:

1) How often do you plan your add more content? Currently, I count less than 150 articles spread across 8 different categories. I probably would read 3 articles a day, which would mean I would have nothing new to look at in less than 2 months. 
Even if I only read 1 article a day, I still would finish this app in less than half a year. 
Why should I subscribe annually??

2) Obviously you can charge whatever you want for a subscription, but I feel $40 annually is too high, especially when one starts to look at other apps in this category. 
I would like to see you offer a one time purchase price instead of a subscription. I would probably pay a one time fee of $40, if I had an assurance of content to be continually added for some time. 

Just my 2¢

Again, I do like this app. Please consider adding a one time purchase option, and comment on adding more content. 

Thank you! 🥂

reviews.title: My brain is mega now
reviews.text: These articles are so interesting and well written. I am a READER…I love to read and I love to learn. And still, these bite size articles give me something that has been unattainable to me since I was in primary school. They almost give that passage you have to scan on the yearly standardized tests to answer multiple choice questions, but without the pressure, in style and length. AND the info it’s giving is full manuscript with all the fat cut out (or only the fat, I love the juicy fat) for a quick read. Want to wow your trivia team? Want to know a little about everything? Looking for a spark to love life again and feel less doomed here on Earth?!?!? (No, really!) It’s reigniting my love for learning at the base level, and giving me comfort about the nature of humanity on a deeper level (like, why did I just cry reading an article about the printing press?!?!?). This Earth is amazing, humans are actually so neat, history is so vast and interesting, thanks for the reminder Nerdish.

reviews.title: Great idea, articles could use better editing
reviews.text:
This is a great idea - spending 10 minutes or so learning some interesting new things is a better way to start the morning than scrolling through social media! The editing is lacking for a lot of articles though, and I don’t know how many writers you have, but some of them are not good - amateurish writing, poor grammar, etc. I realize it has to be a lot of work putting out new content daily, but I’d just as soon work my way through the existing articles and wait for better written material. But overall, the material is very interesting, and I learn a little something new every day! 
Suggestion: add a “needs proofreading“ button.

I’m not sure if it it’s the app, or my phone, but I’m not having this issue with any other app. If I do have to watch adds, that fine, but I at least want to be able to get back to the content I was reading before.
